events.title: Rusalka — Opera Queensland
events.description: Opera Queensland presents Dvořák's romantic opera "Rusalka," inspired by The Little Mermaid, performed in Czech with English surtitles. It features the beloved "Song to the Moon" and tells a luminous tale of a water nymph seduced by a Prince.

events.title: PRAMKICKER — MO Theatre
events.location: QPAC (Cremorne Theatre or Studios) — South Bank
events.description: MO Theatre presents "PRAMKICKER" by Sadie Hasler, an international hit play described as a vulnerable, potty-mouthed love-letter to the modern woman.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA) — South Bank
events.description: A Brisbane-exclusive multi-sensory exhibition by contemporary artist Olafur Eliasson, guiding visitors through rocky landscapes, optical puzzles, and visionary cityscapes spanning three decades of his influential work.

events.title: Lifeline Bookfest Brisbane
events.location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre — South Bank
events.description: A massive community book sale with over a million pre-loved books, CDs, DVDs, and comics available, offering free entry and prices starting from $2.50.

events.title: BSides Brisbane 2026
events.description: Queensland's community-driven hacker conference, focusing on workshop-style presentations, hands-on sessions, and genuine connections in an inclusive environment.

events.title: "Dearly Departed" Exhibition
events.location: State Library of Queensland — South Bank
events.description: A free exhibition at the State Library of Queensland exploring the often-taboo subjects of death and dying, offering a fascinating look at historical and cultural perspectives.

events.title: "Through Mununjali Eyes" — Wayne Coolwell Exhibition
events.location: State Library of Queensland — South Bank
events.description: A free exhibition at the State Library of Queensland celebrating trailblazing broadcaster Wayne Coolwell and offering insights "Through Mununjali Eyes," focusing on Indigenous culture and history.

events.title: Lugger Bort: Research Reveals with Nerelle Nicol
events.location: State Library of Queensland — South Bank
events.description: Monica Clare Fellow Nerelle Nicol shares new community stories on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander working life in northern Queensland's pearling and fishing industries, highlighting injustices faced by workers during NAIDOC Week. Includes a Black Gloves Experience.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: A powerful and thought-provoking exhibition showcasing the world's best photojournalism, returning to the Brisbane Powerhouse.

events.title: Picasso Prints Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition at the Queensland Art Gallery revealing Picasso's first experiments in printmaking, showcasing the young artist's transition and early creative explorations.

events.title: Open Season — Live Music Program
events.location: Various venues (The Tivoli, The Princess Theatre etc.) — Fortitude Valley / City
events.description: Brisbane's defining winter cultural program, Open Season, presents over 100 local, national, and international artists in immersive, surprising, and gritty cross-disciplinary performances across multiple venues.

events.title: UQ Alumni Breakfast: Tax Time Tips
events.description: A casual, free breakfast meetup for UQ alumni in Brisbane CBD, featuring a short session on tax return tips, designed for conversation and connection.

events.title: Aboriginal Art & Symbols Workshop (NAIDOC Week)
events.location: State Library of Queensland — South Bank
events.description: A hands-on workshop to explore Aboriginal art and symbols using natural elements for painting and storytelling, complemented by didgeridoo sounds for healing and dance, presented by Nikita and Caleb during NAIDOC Week.

events.title: State Library Curator's Tours
events.location: State Library of Queensland — South Bank
events.description: Join volunteer guides for a free tour of the State Library of Queensland's award-winning building, learning about its spaces, collections, services, and current exhibitions, customisable to interests.

events.title: QSO: Ravel & MacMillan
events.description: An evening of musical colour, rhythm, and emotion with the Queensland Symphony Orchestra, featuring Ravel's sweeping ballet score *Daphnis and Chloé* and James MacMillan's First Percussion Concerto.
